# VVS Nail Lounge

> Gel-X, nail art & spa pedicures based in Round Rock, Texas. Jasmine's private nail studio in Round Rock: Gel-X, hard gel, hand-painted art and spa pedicures, one client at a time. Clean, calm and never rushed.

- Phone: (228) 243-7011
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Hutto, Cedar Park, Austin
- Google rating: 4.9 from 74 reviews

## Services
- Gel-X extensions: Lightweight, full-coverage soft gel extensions that feel natural. Short $60, medium $65, long $70.
- Custom nail art: Pick No, Simple, Extra or Intensive designs when you book. Send inspo photos and Jasmine hand-paints it.
- Hard gel & dip: Strong, natural-looking structure over your own nails. Overlay from $65, fills from $55, dip powder $55.
- Manicures: Detailed cuticle care every time. Classic manicure $25, gel manicure $40, gel polish change $30.
- Spa pedicures: Four pedicures in the black quilted chair, from the Spa ($45) to the signature Luxe Volcano ($75).
- Cat-eye, chrome & French: Finish any set with a little shine: cat-eye or chrome $10, deep French or ombre $15.

## About
VVS Nail Lounge is Jasmine Truong's private nail studio inside MySalonSuite at 2711 La Frontera Blvd in Round Rock. Jasmine is the owner, a wife and a mom of three, and she built VVS around a simple idea: a clean, calm, elevated nail experience focused on detail, quality and healthy nail care. Every service is done with intention, from meticulous cuticle care to perfectly balanced shaping. Clients say she takes her time and never rushes: Gel-X that looks clean and natural, stilettos filed perfectly even, and custom art that matches the picture in your head, or improves on it. They come back for her, too. Reviews call her sweet, down-to-earth and easy to talk to, the kind of nail artist you start calling your nail bestie. Moms bring their daughters, friends send friends, and the 4.9 rating comes from clients who keep rebooking.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Where is VVS Nail Lounge?
  A: Inside MySalonSuite at 2711 La Frontera Blvd #110, Round Rock, TX 78681. The studio is Suite Room 115.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Seven days a week, 9 AM to 7 PM, by appointment only. Book online through GlossGenius or call (228) 243-7011.
- Q: How much is a Gel-X set?
  A: Gel-X is $60 short, $65 medium and $70 long, or $65 to $75 if you need your old set removed. Cat-eye and chrome are $10 add-ons; deep French and ombre are $15.
- Q: Can I bring my own design?
  A: Yes. Choose Extra or Intensive designs when you book and send inspiration photos ahead so Jasmine can prepare. One client's daughter came in with a design in mind and said Jasmine completely knocked it out of the park.
- Q: Do you do pedicures?
  A: Yes, four of them: Spa ($45), Deluxe ($55), the VVS Lounge with hot stones and spa steamer ($65), and the signature Luxe Volcano ($75). Add gel polish for $15.
- Q: Is there a deposit or cancellation policy?
  A: A $10 non-refundable deposit holds every appointment and goes toward your service. Please cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours ahead; later changes are charged 50% of the service, and no-shows 100%.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: Zelle, Venmo, cash or card. A 3.5% processing fee is added to card payments.
